text_en: A Psalm. A Song for the Sabbath Day.
It is good to give thanks to the Lord , to sing praises to your name, O Most High;
text_cn: 至高者！最幸福的事情， 是赞美上主，歌颂主名，

text_en: to declare your steadfast love in the morning, and your faithfulness by night,
text_cn: 是清晨传扬你的仁慈， 是夜间宣讲你的忠义，

text_en: to the music of the lute and the harp, to the melody of the lyre.
text_cn: 弹奏十弦和七弦的琴瑟， 随着琵琶的旋律而咏诗。

text_en: For you, O Lord , have made me glad by your work; at the works of your hands I sing for joy.
text_cn: 上主，你既以你的化工使我喜悦， 我就因你双手的一切工程欢乐。

text_en: How great are your works, O Lord ! Your thoughts are very deep!
text_cn: 上主，你的工程是多么伟大微妙， 你的计划是多么神秘玄奥！

text_en: The dullard cannot know, the stupid cannot understand this:
text_cn: 无理性的人，不会明白这事， 愚昧的人，也不能领略这事。

text_en: though the wicked sprout like grass and all evildoers flourish, they are doomed to destruction forever,
text_cn: 歹徒虽然一时茂盛有如青草， 作奸犯科的人虽然一时显耀， 然而他们终必灭亡，永远沉消，

text_en: but you, O Lord , are on high forever.
text_cn: 上主，惟有你永远是至尊至高。

text_en: For your enemies, O Lord , for your enemies shall perish; all evildoers shall be scattered.
text_cn: 上主，请看你的仇人， 你的仇人必要沉沦； 作恶的人无处栖身。

text_en: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox; you have poured over me fresh oil.
text_cn: 你高举我的角似野牛的角， 用极新鲜的油膏傅抹了我，

text_en: My eyes have seen the downfall of my enemies; my ears have heard the doom of my evil assailants.
text_cn: 因而我的眼目轻视我的仇人， 我耳欢乐听见制服我的恶人。

text_en: The righteous flourish like the palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
text_cn: 正义的人像棕榈茂盛， 似黎巴嫩的香柏高耸。

text_en: They are planted in the house of the Lord ; they flourish in the courts of our God.
text_cn: 他们被栽植在上主的殿中， 在我们天主的庭院里繁荣。

text_en: In old age they still produce fruit; they are always green and full of sap,
text_cn: 虽已年老，仍然结果， 枝叶繁盛，依旧绿茂；

text_en: showing that the Lord is upright; he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
text_cn: 为宣扬上主是多么正直： 我的磐石，他毫没有不义。
